_comment: Recordings collapsed out of the published corpus. Keyed by the discarded match id. keeper_id is the match that was kept. also_recorded_by on that match is rebuilt from this file, so the credit survives after the raw file is deleted. contained=true means the discarded span sat inside the keeper (120s slack) and the raw file was removed. A recording that sticks out past the keeper stays on disk (raw_removed=false) and is still not published.
